'''Justin Pakes''' (also billed as '''Juz Pakes''' in some Radio Free Decipher indexes) appears as a Decipher SWCCG design guest on late-era Radio Free Decipher episodes covering Coruscant, Reflections III, and Theed Palace topics.<ref name="rfd">[https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Radio_Free_Decipher Radio Free Decipher episode index], LOTR-TCG PC wiki</ref>

This page is a '''thin fan encyclopedia''' stub. Roles below are labeled '''only''' from RFD index descriptions &mdash; not from invented set bylines.

* No primary packaging byline transcribed for Pakes this pass.
* Early RFD uses "Juz"; later indexes use "Justin" &mdash; same person assumed from shared Decipher / RFD context, not proven by a Decipher HR record here.
* No modern long-form interview catalogued in the 2026-09-23 research pack.
